lead.h: "It knows me better than I do": one month in, the desktop assistant keeps 97% of its users
p: The new desktop assistant puts messages, documents, spreadsheets and code in one workbench. Users interviewed say it remembers when they drink water and when they get up, "like a colleague who never gets tired". The maker says that in the past thirty days the assistant has not once said no.
The most-liked comment: "At last I don't have to take a look myself."
